Bamboo-core scented stick; method originated in India at the end of the 19th century; Karnataka leads production.

kinds.d: Candle made for a rite or devotion, in altar, votive, vigil, 7-day, procession and grave or memorial types.

x.d: Beeswax candle lit before icons as an offering while praying for the living and the dead.
Jewish memorial candle lit after the funeral; a yahrzeit candle burns 24 hours.

Hindu ritual bell, traditionally of five to seven metals, rung to announce arrival to the deity; the Tibetan equivalent is the drilbu.
